answer_1.quote: Natural Language Generation (NLG) is a challenging problem in Natural-Language Processing (NLP)
answer_1.outputs: image captions, video captions, visual stories

answer_2.quote: Metrics We utilize six automatic metrics for natural language generation to evaluate the quality of the generated text, including BLEU (Papineni et al.), METEOR (Elliott and Keller, 2013), CIDEr (Vedantam et al.), SPICE (Anderson et al.) and the most recent BERTScore (Zhang et al.) that is based on the pretrained BERT model. We use nlg-eval for the calculation of BLEU, METEOR, ROUGE L and CIDEr.
